[[Bathroom Approach]] |sandbox = No |rewards_increase = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Enemies spawn on 1 of each path.|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Path Spawn Even''' is a modifier present in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]], [[Blind Faith]] and [[Bathroom Approach]]. ==Effects== '''Path Spawn Even''' seemingly does not impact the waves itself, as the way paths work in maps with it looks the same as maps without [[All Paths]], like [[Legacy Gilded Path]]. Therefore, this modifier appears to just be an indicator that enemies will first spawn on the first path, then will move to the next path until reaching the last one, where they loop back to the first path. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''Path Spawn Even''' added. *'''25 October 2025''' - [[v1.78.0]] **'''Path Spawn Even''' is now active in [[Banlands]]. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **'''Path Spawn Even''' is now active in [[Blind Faith]]. *'''3 April 2026''' - [[v1.88.0]] **'''Path Spawn Even''' is now active in [[Bathroom Approach]]. {{ModifierNavBox}}
